It introduced the [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode rework. This update encompassed seven updates, the main v1.45.0 update (released 11 December 2024) and six minor updates, v1.45.1 (released 11 December 2024), v1.45.1a (released 16 December 2024), v1.45.1b (released 16 December 2024), v1.45.1c (released 16 December 2024), v1.45.1d (released 16 December 2024) and v1.45.1e (released 16 December 2024). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== *[[Elite Abnormal]] Given out 2-4 times. ***[[Mid Grade Crate]] added as an {{Color|Uncommon}} reward. Given out 1 time. ***[[Turkey Leg]] added as an {{Color|Uncommon}} reward. Given out 1-3 times. ***[[Pumpkin Bomb]] added as an {{Color|Uncommon}} reward. Given out 1-2 times. **Now uses the new income system. ***[[Napalm Strike]] added as an {{Color|Rare}} reward. Given out 2-3 times. ***[[Blizzard Bomb]] added as an {{Color|Rare}} reward. Given out 2-3 times. ***[[High Grade Crate]] added as an {{Color|Rare}} reward. Given out 1 time. ***[[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] added as an {{Color|Rare}} reward. Given out 1-2 times. **Starting cash is now {{Money|500}} regardless of player count. **Updated mode icon. **Description chagned. **Ambient music added. **Level requirement increased from {{Level|0}} to {{Level|15}}. *[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode wave structure updated. *[[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode updated. **Updaded description. **Updated icon. **Changed Wave 24 and 28 dialogue. *[[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode updated. **Updated icon. **Updated dialogue. *[[Imposter]] no longer gives a badge when killed, due to it being disabled. *''Suspicious...'' and ''Defeat Legacy Fallen King'' rewards can no longer be claimed in [[Rewards]], due to their badges being disabled. *Fixed [[War Machine]] not granting [[Damage Buff]]s to towers in its range. *Fixed [[Abyssal Trench]] and [[Construction Crazy]] not appearing in regular intermission lobby map selection. *Fixed [[Unknown Garden]] not appearing in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] intermission lobby map selection. *Fixed
